_description: Reverse-engineered from Figma TRATON branch BRANCH:checkbox-radio-toggle-13 (cluster 13, CDEP-1967). Most component variables use a single 4-mode semantic alias per row; brand/mode swap is handled by the semantic layer. Background-selected and -indeterminate use 4-mode brand-primitive direct aliases (TRATON blue/950 + base/white; Scania grey/950 + grey/50) per Tegel UI Library source-of-truth — endpoints copied from color/icon/strong's resolution chain to preserve visual while resolving the icon-to-background property-match smell at the component-token level.
_notes: Variant-axis-preservation rule applied: border + background split per variant (standard/selected/indeterminate) even where values are identical. Icon follows canvas evidence (no glyph on standard). Text label sits off the varying surface — no variant axis.

Indicator has no variant axis by design: the hover overlay ring is visually identical across all three checkbox variants. Single border/indicator-default + border/indicator-hover pair covers all variants.

Background-selected and -indeterminate tokens use brand-primitive direct aliases (blue/950 + base/white TRATON; grey/950 + grey/50 Scania) — endpoints copied from color/icon/strong's resolution chain per Tegel UI Library source-of-truth. This resolves the prior icon-to-background property-match smell at the component-token level. A foundation-level color/background/inverse/strong semantic would let this collapse back to a single alias if added later.
Indicator overlay code-side: checkbox uses ::before background-color, structure is a stroke layer in Figma — Phase 6 implementation alignment item.
Indicator hover uses color/border/subtle; Radio Button hover ring uses color/border/discrete (locked as-is; designer handover item to confirm intentional divergence).
Focus-ring radius value is bind-time-adjustable per the checkbox's square shape (≠ Chip's pill).

Disabled state via wrapper-only opacity-disabled pattern (LOCKED, see convention-opacity-disabled-wrapper.md): Checkbox/Input root owns opacity for standalone use (Dropdown etc.); Checkbox/Item root owns opacity AND forces nested Input instance to Disabled=False so opacities don't compound; Label Text inherits dim multiplicatively from Item root. No *-disabled color tokens; no Label-level opacity binding.
Focus state via component/-focus/* helper. No component-level border/focus token.

Component topology (LOCKED, see convention-component-topology.md): Checkbox/Input (Source, 30515:78570) + Checkbox/Item (Wrapper, 30515:78521) + Checkbox Group (Layout wrapper, 30515:79481). Bindings live on Source; Wrapper owns Label Text + parent opacity; Group inherits.

Pre-existing Indicator alias divergence (informational): Input source binds Indicator stroke to color/border/inverse/subtle; Item wrapper's instance had an override to color/border/subtle. Both now bind via component/checkbox/border/indicator-hover, which aliases color/border/subtle — chose non-inverse for cluster consistency. Designer handover candidate to confirm intent.

Axis-name divergence (designer handover candidate): Checkbox/Item uses Selected=True/False axis; Checkbox/Input uses Checked=True/False. Same concept, different label. Item axis order also differs from Input's. No functional impact; flag for normalization.

Vector glyphs not yet brand-aware (designer handover candidate): Symbol/Icon-Check-Temp and Symbol/Indeterminate are VECTOR layers, not instances of icons from a brand-aware icon library. They won't swap per brand. The 'Icon / Check / Temp' layer name also needs renaming to a stable name.

variables.name: component/checkbox/border/standard-hover
variables.comment: Hover state — outer border unchanged; visual hover comes from indicator overlay.

variables.name: component/checkbox/border/selected-default
variables.comment: Selected variant has no outer border (fill-only).

variables.name: component/checkbox/border/indeterminate-default
variables.comment: Indeterminate variant has no outer border (fill-only).

variables.name: component/checkbox/border/indicator-default
variables.comment: Hover-overlay ring at rest (transparent). Single token applied across all 3 checkbox variants — no variant axis on indicator.

variables.name: component/checkbox/border/indicator-hover
variables.comment: Hover-overlay ring on hover. Radio Button uses color/border/discrete here — divergence locked, flagged for designer handover.

variables.name: component/checkbox/background/selected-default
variables.comment: Filled box when selected. 4-mode brand-primitive direct, endpoints copied from color/icon/strong's resolution chain per Tegel UI source: TRATON Light blue/950 / Dark base/white; Scania Light grey/950 / Dark grey/50. Resolved the prior icon-to-background alias smell at the component level.

variables.name: component/checkbox/background/indeterminate-default
variables.comment: Filled box when indeterminate — identical alias matrix to selected.

variables.name: component/checkbox/icon/selected-default
variables.comment: Checkmark glyph on filled box. Cross-swap of background-selected — semantic resolves white on dark fill (Light) and dark on white fill (Dark).

variables.name: component/checkbox/icon/indeterminate-default
variables.comment: Dash glyph on filled box — identical alias matrix to selected checkmark.

variables.name: component/checkbox/text/default
variables.comment: Label sits adjacent to the box — off the varying surface. No variant axis by design.

variables.name: component/checkbox/border/radius-default
variables.comment: Corner radius on the Input rectangle (the box itself). 2px primitive. 4-mode per brand-primitive-aliases convention (LOCKED) — each brand has independent primitives. Distinct from focus-ring/radius-default which addresses the focus ring (different purpose, different value due to focus offset placement).

variables.name: component/checkbox/focus-ring/radius-default
variables.comment: Refs shared -focus utility group. Size (small/medium/full) is bind-time adjustable — checkbox is square, ≠ Chip's pill.

variables.name: component/checkbox/opacity/disabled
variables.comment: 25% opacity for disabled state. 4-mode per brand-primitive-aliases convention (LOCKED) — each brand has independent primitives.
